008AED42.directions: From the spawn above, face east and keep following the river down. This bit is a little tricky: while you walk down the river, keep looking to your left, along the skyline, until you are in line with the red top of the Hawksbill Weather Station. Facing the weather station, walk straight while looking up the hill and hopefully you will see two green tents. There is an enemy spawn at the tents, so even if you miss them the first time, the enemies should see you, start attacking and lead you to the tents. I have STRONG words for the devs who placed this jar spawn here. Once you are standing at the tents, face west and walk to the back of the tent. The Brain in a Jar is behind the two wooden crates on your right.

008AF90B.directions: From the spawn above, face north-east and walk to the bottom of the stairs in front of you. Stand at the bottom of the stairs, face north-east again and walk forward, following the top of the cliff face around for a while until you see another camp site with a stargazer telescope on your right. Face north-west and walk over to the tree next to the cooking station. The Brain in a Jar is next to the sleeping bag in front of you.

008AF90C.directions: Fast travel back to the Three Ponds map marker and face north-west. Jump, jetpack or whatever and keep going up the hill. This one is miles away, so keep walking straight and check you are staying north-west. You will climb up three rock faces until you reach a viewing platform at the top. Walk over to the platform and stand next to the blue water pump. Turn right and the Brain in a Jar is under the stairs, next to the wooden crates.

008AF90D.directions: From the spawn in location, face south and walk forward until you see the sheet of wood laying on the ground in front of you, turn right and walk up to the top of the hill and stop next to the white tent. Face east and the Brain in a Jar is inside the yellow wooden crate at the bottom of the tree.

008AF90E.directions: From the spawn above, stand on top of the yellow crate and face south. Walk forward and drop down so you are standing at the bottom of the waterfall. Face west and you will see the Brain in a Jar on the rock behind the waterfall.

008AF90F.directions: From the spawn above, fast travel back to the Three Ponds map marker, face south and walk back over to where the Brain in a Jar was under the waterfall. From behind the waterfall, face east and walk straight, jump off the cliffs and keep following the river down until you get to a cute rock stack and a camera on your right. The Brain in a Jar is leaning against the large rock next to the rock stack. What is it meant to be? A bird?
